answer: A new identity spends its first 5 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 30% of full weight. Because the velvet weight is recomputed from the horizon history each close, the raven audit exposes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for every alias, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 39 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
